name: rails-query-command
description: Run read-only queries against a Rails app's database via `rails query` (Rails 8.2+, or 7.2–8.1 with the rails-query-command gem) — ActiveRecord or SQL, schema/model introspection, EXPLAIN, pagination, and remote execution through any command template in $REMOTE_RAILS_QUERY (Heroku, SSH, docker, kubectl, …).
